name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation menu
description: Site navigation (Base UI Navigation Menu): a control frame of section triggers and links, the open trigger inverse, the current page cobalt; each section's panel docks to the frame's keyline with link cells on shared seams (title, description, code).
whenToUse: Use it for a website's navigation where sections open a panel of links. For an app's own sections use Nav; for an app's commands use Menubar.

parts.name: NavigationMenu
parts.description: The root with its popup in place: the list goes inside, the panel docks under it.

parts.name: NavigationMenuCard
parts.description: A link cell in a panel: title, description, code. `active` marks the current page.

props.name: code
props.description: A Code-voice identifier at the cell's end (a service code, a terminal code).

parts.name: NavigationMenuContent
parts.description: A section's panel content; it swaps in place inside the popup.

parts.name: NavigationMenuGrid
parts.description: The panel's links as cells on shared seams: two columns where there is room, one where there is not. Each cell draws its end and bottom keylines; the grid's negative end and bottom margins hide the last ones.

parts.name: NavigationMenuLink
parts.description: A top-level link cell (no panel). `active` marks the current page (aria-current="page", cobalt).

parts.name: NavigationMenuPopup
parts.description: The panel: Base UI's Portal, Positioner, Popup and Viewport in one part, with the positioner's placement props lifted. Docked to the frame (the list), not the open trigger: the trigger sits inside the frame's k2 border, so a trigger-anchored panel ran k2 inside the frame's edge. On the frame, the panel's top border lies on the frame's bottom border (sideOffset -k2) and their outer start edges coincide; the panel stays put between sections and never animates its size. It carries the configuration of the place it is written.

parts.name: NavigationMenuRoot
parts.description: The root: Base UI's NavigationMenu.Root, told the DOM's reading direction.
